content: {"rules": ["The model consistently underestimates volatility by predicting smooth linear trends while the true outcome exhibits sharp mean-reversion spikes.", "When sentiment history shows mixed signals (0.33 to 1.00), the forecast fails to capture sudden reversals seen in the true outcome.", "Forecast bias is evident as the model assumes gradual drift whereas actual prices frequently drop 5-8% within a single week.", "Sentiment peaks often precede immediate price drops rather than confirming continued upward momentum.", "The model ignores historical volatility clustering, leading to significant overshoots or undershoots in short-term forecasts.", "True outcomes display high frequency noise that the linear forecast smooths out completely.", "Relying solely on sentiment history without accounting for recent price momentum leads to systematic forecasting errors."] }
